proposal.reason: Primary change is in the IB network backend: connection metadata/handshake and readiness flow, QP RTR/RTS setup, FLID/GID routing, ECE negotiation, traffic-class handling, and receive-size completion behavior in net_ib + ibvwrap. Add memory because the new per-device MR cache introduces reference-counted registration reuse/deregistration ownership semantics. Add gin because GIN-specific connect/accept/listen cleanup paths were changed (pcclIbAcceptForGin, cancel hooks, and listener-close behavior), which is a substantive GIN integration change beyond mechanical call-site updates.
